name: mofa-podcast
author: hagency
description: Multi-speaker podcast generation with TTS voice synthesis and audio assembly

tools.name: podcast_voices
tools.description: List all available voices for podcast speakers. Shows preset (built-in) voices and any saved custom/cloned voices. Call this when helping the user choose voices for their speakers.

tools.name: podcast_voice_save
tools.description: Save a reference audio file as a cloned voice for podcast generation. The audio must be a WAV file (RIFF format). After saving, the voice can be used in scripts as clone:{name}.

name.description: Voice name identifier (e.g., 'trump'). Only alphanumeric, underscore, and hyphen allowed. Will be sanitized if needed.

audio_path.description: Path to the reference audio WAV file. Can be absolute or relative to the workspace.

force.description: If true, overwrite existing voice with the same name. Default: false.

tools.name: podcast_generate
tools.spawn_only_message: SUCCESS: Podcast generation is now running in background. Voice segments are being generated and will be assembled into the final audio file. The audio file will be automatically delivered when ready.
tools.description: Generate the full podcast audio from an approved markdown script. Validates and deterministically repairs common markdown drift such as bold-wrapped speaker headers, multiline dialogue blocks, and full-width header punctuation before parsing. Then generates TTS for each segment via local VoxCPM batch engine, concatenates in timeline order with pauses, and outputs a single final audio file. This runs in background — do NOT wait for it.

script.description: The full markdown podcast script content. Canonical dialogue format is [Character - voice, emotion] text, but the validator can repair common markdown formatting drift before synthesis.

script_path.description: Path to the markdown script file. Alternative to providing script content directly.

output_dir.description: Directory for output files. Defaults to skill-output/mofa-podcast/
